question: What is 2.4. Insurance?
expected_answer: 2.4. Insurance • Insurance Policy – Contract between individual and insurance company. question: What is 3.1. Line of Credit?
expected_answer: 3.1. Line of Credit • Loan from banks and financial institutions that set a maximum loan amount (credit limit) that an individual is allowed to borrow • Borrowers cannot withdraw beyond the permitted limit • The borrower has the flexibility to withdraw the loan amount in a lump sum or installments • Bank charges only on the withdrawn amount, not the remaining available balance of the loan https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/short-term-loans/
